name: opencode-anti-slop

scripts.gates: node scripts/anti-slop/check-modularity.mjs --src scripts/anti-slop && node scripts/anti-slop/check-imports.mjs --src scripts && node scripts/anti-slop/check-docs.mjs --src scripts/anti-slop && node scripts/anti-slop/check-duplicates.mjs --src scripts
